notes: RNC-seq: RNA was extracted from ribosome-nascent chain complexes pelleted through a sucrose cushion, not from whole cells -> assay_class other. S1 (rpsA) wild-type vs K247Q overexpression; no reference-genotype control (S1WT overexpression is the comparison baseline), is_control left out. K247Q overexpression labelled multiple (point mutant allele overexpressed). Sampled 3 h after IPTG at OD 0.6: no growth phase.

inducer_added.q: When strains  cultrued to OD600 0.6，1mM IPTG was added to the strains.

treatment.q: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains grown in LB medium are used for RNC-seq

transcription_arrested.q: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains grown in LB medium are used for RNC-seq

mixed_organism.q: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains grown in LB medium are used for RNC-seq

perturbed_genes.q: simulated acetylation mutant S1K247Q of S1 protein

global_regulator_perturbed.q: simulated acetylation mutant S1K247Q of S1 protein

assay_class.q: then ultracentrifuged at 4°C by T-865 fixed angle rotor (ThermoFisher, Germany) to pellet RNCs
